tools.name: read_public_catalog
tools.description: List available public World Bank indicators and Election.org civic research collections/charts. No personal notebooks, opinions, feedback, voice or account data.

tools.name: read_public_indicator
tools.description: Read sourced World Bank indicator observations with units, notes, update dates and missing values. Compare at most two three-letter country codes. Never substitute estimated chart points.

tools.name: read_public_civic_records
tools.description: Read existing public Election.org collections or a catalog chart. Preserve citations, methodology, coverage and dates. Does not read private participants, political profiles or user conversations.
